decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Allosaurus Rider combo to bring out powerful creatures like Griselbrand or Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. Using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Neoform, the deck aims to cheat out its big threats ahead of schedule. Consign to Memory can be used to dig for combo pieces, while Pact of Negation provides protection. The deck also includes acceleration with cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Xenagos, God of Revels. Overall, the key strategy is to ramp up quickly and overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures while protecting the combo.

The main idea behind this UW Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan and control the board by countering spells, removing threats, and drawing cards. Using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tune the Narrative to control the tempo of the game, while using cards like Solitude and Wrath of the Skies to deal with threats. The deck's win conditions include Quantum Riddler and Otawara, Soaring City, with a mana base that allows for easy access to all the colors needed for control spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on using small, aggressive creatures combined with burn spells and combat tricks to quickly overpower the opponent. Cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer provide an early aggressive start, while Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge offer additional reach and removal. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Static Prison and Thraben Charm to disrupt the opponent's strategies. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to apply constant pressure, using a mix of creatures, burn spells, and disruptive elements to close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays with cheap spells and creatures to deal damage to the opponent quickly. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of burn spells, swift creatures, and cards that provide card advantage and selection to maintain pressure. The deck utilizes the prowess ability to pump up creatures and has ways to deal with opposing threats with cards like Lightning Bolt and Slickshot Show-Off. The mana base includes fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistency and speed in casting spells.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deploy creatures and deal damage to the opponent as efficiently as possible. With a mix of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, as well as removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Arena of Glory and Goblin Bombardment provide additional ways to push through damage and win the game.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering key spells, removing threats, and drawing extra cards with Narset, Parter of Veils and Meticulous Archive. The deck also includes some win conditions such as Teferi, Time Raveler and Monumental Henge to close out the game. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around controlling the board and outvaluing the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using various mill cards to deplete the opponent's library quickly, while also utilizing control cards like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to disrupt their game plan. The key strategy is to mill the opponent out as fast as possible, taking advantage of cards like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab to continuously chip away at their library. With efficient removal spells and disruptive cards like Archive Trap and Surgical Extraction, the deck aims to control the game and win through milling the opponent to zero cards in their library.

The main focus of this deck is to use cards that mill the opponent's library, such as Ruin Crab and Fractured Sanity, along with Archive Trap and Tasha's Hideous Laughter. The deck also includes disruption spells like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board. Additionally, the deck includes support cards like Preordain and Jace, the Perfected Mind to help draw into key pieces. The land base includes utility lands like Oboro, Palace in the Clouds and Shelldock Isle to further enhance the deck's strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble and protect the combo of using Goblin Charbelcher to deal lethal damage to the opponent with minimal resources. It utilizes a combination of counterspells, card draw, and spell recursion to disrupt the opponent and protect the combo pieces until it can be executed. The deck focuses on efficiency and speed, aiming to win the game before the opponent has a chance to set up their own game plan. This landless combo deck relies heavily on careful timing and precise decision-making to secure victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive strategies with a mix of creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It includes efficient creatures like Ragavan and Phlage, as well as powerful planeswalkers like Ajani. Supporting cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge help push through damage and control the board. The deck also utilizes lands like Sacred Foundry and Flooded Strand to ensure mana consistency. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and consistent stream of threats while disrupting their game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies combined with blink effects to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan and apply pressure. It includes cards like Thoughtseize for disruption, Ephemerate for repeated value, and creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk for aggression. The deck also utilizes cards like Flickerwisp and Solitude to blink in and out creatures for additional value. By combining aggressive creatures with blink effects, this deck aims to outpace opponents and control the board to secure victory.

The key concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy, strip their hand of important cards with Thoughtseize, counter their spells with Counterspell and Force of Negation, and control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through spells like Stern Scolding and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, while applying pressure with efficient threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Murktide Regent. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth and consistent casting of spells throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing blink effects to repeatedly trigger powerful enter the battlefield abilities of creatures. By blinking creatures like Flickerwisp and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd with cards like Ephemerate, players can disrupt opponents' strategies and generate value. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board while overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Emperor of Bones. This strategy aims to outmaneuver opponents and maintain board advantage through efficient use of blink effects and strong creature abilities.

The deck focuses on quickly generating mana with cards like Manamorphose and Ruby Medallion to cast powerful spells like Past in Flames and Grapeshot. Ral, Monsoon Mage and Wish provide additional utility and card advantage while Desperate Ritual and Pyretic Ritual help to further accelerate the deck's mana generation. The deck looks to chain spells together to create a storm of spells that overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a single turn. The deck is built to be fast and explosive, aiming to win the game before the opponent can fully react.

This Aggro-Blink deck focuses on rapidly deploying creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and using cards like Ephemerate to repeatedly flicker them in and out of play for added value. Thoughtseize helps disrupt opponents' strategies while synergizing with cards like Solitude for removal. The deck also includes graveyard hate like Relic of Progenitus and Quantum Riddler to handle opposing strategies. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed, disruption, and value generation through blinking creatures in and out of play.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a combination of powerful creatures and burn spells. It utilizes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to put pressure on the opponent early on, while also using cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to deal direct damage. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and finish the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. Additionally, cards like Arena of Glory and Static Prison help to control the board and protect the aggressive creatures from removal.
